role: Pandu's elder wife; mother of Yudhishthira, Bhima and Arjuna (and Karna)
look: About 30, composed and strong. Warm medium-brown skin. Cream bodice and antariya with a maroon border; an ochre uttariya worn over her head as a veil. Red thread, bindi, no gold.
sourceNotes: Born Pritha of the Yadavas, adopted by Kuntibhoja (Adi §111). The veil and colours are design choices (concept C).
notes: Built from the pandu rig (same head construction and joint pivots; legs hidden under the antariya) by episodes/S01E02-kindama-curses-pandu/svg/make-women.py, concept C. All poses face right; mirror in the scene with flip. No gold: Pandu gave his wives' ornaments away (Adi §119).
